cohort: Pregnant women who underwent cesarean hysterectomy with histology-proven PAS between 23 0/7 and 42 0/7 weeks gestational age
finding: While not associated with a higher risk of perioperative complications, complicated PAS was associated with earlier delivery, increased need for antenatal blood transfusions, and longer maternal length of stay.
birth_weight: Median birthweights were lower for complicated PAS
